paper.title: Memory Tax: Dissecting the Net Value of Agent Memory
paper.summary: Memory is increasingly used in long-horizon agents, yet the net value of building memory over direct retrieval from raw history remains largely unclear. Through a large-scale evaluation across multiple benchmarks and model backbones, we find many dedicated memory systems underperform naive RAG in many cases.
paper.ai_summary: Dedicated memory systems often underperform naive RAG.

paper.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning for Robotic Manipulation
paper.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, with reinforcement learning and reasoning.
